title: fix(ui): rich-text cell docs, the read-only data-table warning and the onBatchSave refusal describe the select-first model
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoPm5yqPvuwrjEV9JhFTrVJj)_

## 维护者速读
- 表格只剩「先选中、每格提交即保存」一种编辑方式。fields 包随包发布的 README 和注释、`data-table` 只读警告、`onBatchSave` 的拒收文字，现在都按这一种方式说话。
- 读包文档或看控制台警告的宿主开发者不会再被指向已经没有的保存按钮，也不会被叫去挂一个挂不上的类型名。
- 只改文字，并删掉表格里恒为真的判断；哪些写法被拒、键盘怎么用都不变。
- 无。卡的另一半（5 个已发布 CHANGELOG 里的两行）按座位裁定在本 PR 合入后单开纯文档 PR。

## What changes
- **`@object-ui/fields` README, "The grid cell editor's face"** and the `IN_CELL_PANEL_EDIT_WIDGETS` docblock in `FieldEditWidget.tsx`: the sentence "a grid without `cellSelection` opens it over the cell, where Ctrl/Cmd+Enter does nothing and a click outside keeps the text as a pending change for the grid's save buttons" is gone. They now say the grid edits only in its select-first model and opens the rich-text box in the panel under the cell.
- **The over-the-cell branch is unreachable, and its residue in `data-table.tsx` is retired.** `editable` is `editableProp && selectFirst && onRowSave`, and `startEdit` returns at once when the table is not `editable`, so no editor ever opens outside the select-first model. Removed as always-true or always-false: the `selectFirst` conjunct in `editsBelow`; in the host-injected editor's key handler, the `selectFirst &&` guards on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter in a textarea, on Tab, and on `commitMoves`; `focusSelectionRef.current = selectFirst` in the injected editor's `commit` and Escape paths (now `true`); `!selectFirst ||` in the injected-editor caret effect. The comment describing Tab "outside the select-first model" is replaced by the invariant. The non-edit `selectFirst` branches (selection, the read-only table's arrow navigation, `onRowClick`'s pointer cursor) are live and untouched, and `CellOverlay`'s `cover` placement stays (plain editors use it).
- **N3.** `describeUnsavableEditable` (`dataTableBindDiagnostic.ts`) named `GridCellSelection`, the context's value type, as the thing to mount. It now names `GridCellSelectionProvider` in both places, and in its docblock.
- **N4.** `handlerKeyRefusal` (`tombstone.zod.ts`, internal to `@object-ui/types`, not exported) takes an optional fourth argument: a `'retired'` key's own remedy, which replaces the node-type remedy. Omitted, the message is byte-for-byte unchanged. Passed for a `'runtime-slot'` key, it throws at declaration. `DataTableSchema.onBatchSave` passes "`onBatchSave` → `onRowSave` on `object-grid`…", ending "Delete the key." The key is refused exactly as before (`custom` at its own path, a live function too).
- **N5.** Removed: the two queries of the deleted `data-table-edit-column-header` test id (autosave and select-first harnesses; both tests keep their live assertions, and the autosave test name drops "no edit column"); `inlineEditPermissionGate.test.tsx` case e and its `headerCellCount` helper; `defaultBatchSave` from the `affordanceGrantMap-12082` comment.
- One `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/types`.

## Why
#35827 retired the staged editing model. Shipped text (the fields README is in the package's `files[]`) still described it, and the warning told hosts to mount a type. Contract record 7189751333 on PR #37437 named all of it.

## Verification
Tests added or tightened, each ablated on the committed fix (put back, run, restored from `HEAD`, tree clean):
- `data-table-autosave-35685.test.tsx` "without the provider: …": the warning names `` `GridCellSelectionProvider` `` twice and never `` `GridCellSelection` ``. Ablation (both names back): `1 failed | 23 passed (24)`.
- `handler-keys-json-refusal-6124.test.ts`: the per-site guidance test now takes an `OWN_RETIREMENT_REMEDY` table (`onBatchSave` → its FROM → TO, `GridCellSelectionProvider`, "Delete the key.", and no `action:button`); a new top-level describe pins the helper itself (default text byte-exact, the remedy replaces only the remedy sentence, a runtime slot refuses one, every own-remedy key is a retired ledger site). Ablations: `onBatchSave` back to the generic call, `1 failed | 343 passed (344)`; the helper ignoring the argument, `2 failed | 342 passed (344)`.
- `data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx`, new describe "an injected editor keeps the model's keys": a host-injected textarea editor commits on Tab and moves right, keeps Enter as a new line and commits on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter with the cell still selected. These hold the two arms whose `selectFirst &&` guard was removed. Ablations: Tab arm removed, `1 failed | 38 passed (39)`; the textarea Ctrl/Cmd+Enter arm removed, `1 failed | 38 passed (39)`.
- Case e's replacement: "sends one update with that cell only, draws no save bar, no row Save button and no amber row" in `data-table-autosave-35685.test.tsx` and "no edit-only column, ever" in `data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx` pin at the table itself that an editable table draws no save column; case e compared three header counts that can no longer differ.
- No table without a select-first host edits: already pinned by "no staged fallback" in `data-table-autosave-35685.test.tsx` (no editor opens, no save bar, one warning).

<details><summary>Readings at c6bf4f66 (base origin/main 815e882b)</summary>

- Six touched test files: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 499 passed (499)`.
- `vitest run packages/components/ packages/types/ packages/fields/ packages/plugin-grid/ packages/plugin-form/` after an `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` build: `1796 passed | 6 failed | 2 skipped`. The six are spec-parity tests that read `packages/spec/dist/*.d.mts`, which that build does not write ("no module symbol for …/spec/dist/system/index.d.mts"). After a dts build of `@object-ui/plugin-grid^...` and `@object-ui/plugin-form^...`, those six: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 145 passed (145)`.
- `type-check` exit 0 for `@object-ui/types`, `components`, `fields`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-form`.
- `eslint` on the ten changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors (warnings pre-existing).
- `check:doc-authoring` exit 0; `check:new-line-citations` 0 new; `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-fixed` exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the surface: no path-derived tier mandate; no governed path.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- The `.changeset/pre/35827-…` file and the five published CHANGELOG entries (spec, app-shell, components, plugin-grid, types) still say `mount GridCellSelection` / `inside a GridCellSelection host`. Seat ruling: a dedicated docs-only PR after this one merges, which then `Fixes #37521`.
- Seen and left, outside the claimed surface: the `renderSelectFirstTable` docblock in `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/test-utils.tsx` says "a select-first host (`GridCellSelection`)", naming the model, not the thing to mount.
- The test harness `handler-keys-json-refusal-6124.test.ts` is the shared harness for `handlerKeyRefusal`; its per-site guidance assertion had to learn the own-remedy case, which is why it is in the diff.

## Human Minimum
- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
